qualifying_population.enumerated_from: scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json (committed), by walking all thirteen scenarios for any node whose source is 'Imperial Mandate - Command'.
qualifying_population.rule: Only a published Command mark can gain the two scope fields, because _packet writes them at the one site that authors that mark and the receipt view publishes them only when present. The enumeration is therefore total over the committed baseline and bounds what may qualify. Every other leaf this slice can reach is an id or a value the shipped default reproduces unchanged, so any movement there is an unexpected occurrence and stops the slice.

not_a_member.why: The applied factor on a damage row, not the mark record; it carries no scope field and does not move.

/coupled_scenarios/mandate_abyssal_curse.new: Ahri E declares no reviewed crowd-control scope (H2, deferred with the default shipped), so this mark is delivered to the single defender of the pair fight it was priced in: a claim about one fight, not about the roster.

oracle_pass.why: R-15's amendment of 2026-08-14: a membership transition that is the ruled consequence of a declared change is adjudicated BY CITATION, not by verdict. Both occurrences are absent_to_value -- as the identity-keyed leaf_report classifies them, which is the amendment's first guard -- on fields that did not exist at capture, and the ruling that puts them there is one a reader can open: the umbrella's [H] table, row H2, 'Recorded ruling, 2026-08-13, at Phase 4 S7: deferred, default shipped ... CcScope.Unreviewed resolves to SingleTarget on the pair defender with a disclosure naming the ability', which is the amendment's second guard. No oracle receipt is owed on either, and one may not be filed as though the question were a value question: no cached wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md decides whether a disclosure field should exist.
oracle_pass.what_an_oracle_would_still_be_owed: Any numeric movement. There is none: 0 numeric leaves moved, the pair baseline reads 'snapshot identical', and scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json reproduces every one of its 82 per-attacker totals unchanged.
oracle_pass.the_question_h2_is_still_blocked_on: How many roster targets one Syndra E cone stun applies to, and on what source. Answering it is authoring MultiTarget(cap=n) on the ability that earned it -- a value in the vocabulary this slice ships, not a new routing concept -- and it re-opens Command's authority move as its own slice with its own Expected qualifying occurrences line.
